title: The Brain, Body, and Behaviour Dataset (1.0.0) - Experiment 2
description: Multimodal dataset of 31 participants who watched five short educational videos in two sessions: an attentive condition followed by factual memory questions, and a distracted condition in which participants silently counted backwards. Recordings include EEG, ECG, EOG, gaze position, pupil size, blinks, saccades and head motion. Questionnaire data (stimulus knowledge and memory questions, ASRS adult ADHD checklist) are provided, supporting research on attention, incidental learning and physiological correlates of engagement.
methods_description: Participants watched five informative YouTube videos without knowing they would be tested (incidental learning). In session 1 (attentive) they answered domain and memory multiple-choice questions for each video. In session 2 (distracted) they rewatched the videos in the same order while silently counting backwards from a random prime number in steps of 7, with no questions afterward. EEG, ECG, EOG, head motion, gaze coordinates and pupil size were recorded. EEG was converted to BDF and physiological and eye-tracking data to tsv.gz using MATLAB.
